name: @postpin-io/resolve-plugin
description: PostPin workflow integration plugin for DaVinci Resolve

scripts.setup:mac: P="/Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/Workflow Integration Plugins/com.postpin.resolve" && sudo rm -rf "$P" && sudo mkdir -p "$P" && sudo chown "$USER" "$P"
scripts.install:mac: P="/Library/Application Support/Blackmagic Design/DaVinci Resolve/Workflow Integration Plugins/com.postpin.resolve" && pnpm run build && rm -rf "$P"/* && cp -R dist/. "$P"
